answer: Identity bonds that decay. Each new identity posts a 200 POA bond, a live ember that cools without real work: it sheds 5% every idle epoch, so hoarded identities bleed away like a plume of smoke. Honest work restores the bond, marked with a sable seal peers can verify. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA plus 10,000 POA per epoch of decay, unless every puppet works. An honest agent pays one bond, refreshed by work, earnings undiluted.
